description: Task templates that fire when a matter enters an attorney-owned stage. Turns each SLA into a concrete to-do (or checklist) in the app's task system. Client-owned stages are handled by the nudge engine, not tasks. Each task carries a soft internal due date (buffer) and the hard SLA deadline.

v2_additions.gate: On a checklist item or on a whole template. Either a plan-flag key (real_estate, credit_shelter, minor_children, pets, diy_signing, legal_plan) or an array of design-sheet plan types. Absent means always. Turning a flag on mid-stage appends its items to the open task; turning it off removes only items that are still incomplete — completed work is never deleted.
v2_additions.produces_document: On a checklist item: that item IS the document's status. There is no document_checklist column set, and none is coming — the checklist is the checklist.

scope.client_stages: Not tasked — driven by the nudge engine (see nudge_schedule / config/nudge-templates.json).
scope.date_bounded_stages: Discovery/PMPS is client-scheduled; no attorney work task.

untasked_engine_keys.design_input: Pre-design-meeting intake handling. The intake surfaces drive it; a task would duplicate them.
untasked_engine_keys.client_review: The client's move. The nudge engine chases it; an attorney task would only be noise.
untasked_engine_keys.approved: Also the client's move — waiting on them to schedule.
untasked_engine_keys.matter_closed: End state. Nothing left to do.
untasked_engine_keys.note: This gap is deliberate, not an oversight. UNTASKED_ENGINE_KEYS in types/database.ts is the same list, and a test holds the two together.

due_date_model.description: Two dates per task. The soft date is the internal target that creates urgency before the SLA bites; the hard date is the SLA itself, which drives the dashboard red flag.

fields.hard_due_at: stage_entered_at + sla_days (business days). The SLA; matches stage_sla. Null sla_days means no hard deadline — the task recurs on its soft date instead.
fields.computed_in: business days, America/New_York, excluding firm_holidays (reuse business_days_elapsed inverse).

due_date_model.display_rule: Surface soft_due_at as the task's working due date; show hard_due_at as the SLA badge. Task goes amber at soft_due_at, red at hard_due_at.

granularity_rationale.proposal_ea_out: Single headline task — it's one fast generate-and-send action; a checklist would be overkill.
granularity_rationale.design: Checklist — the design meeting produces decisions, and the gated items are the ones a plan without that flag must not carry.
granularity_rationale.drafting: Checklist — this is the multi-step block (generate, QA, format, PDF, send) and the place sub-steps get dropped. Each drafted document is one item, so the checklist is the document status.
granularity_rationale.revisions: Short checklist — pull structured changes, edit, cross-check, resend; cross-check is the step that protects against inconsistency.
granularity_rationale.signing_scheduled: Checklist — signing prep is real attorney work even though the appointment itself is client-scheduled.
granularity_rationale.closeout: Checklist — funding package, summary, portal stage update, deliver; several discrete deliverables.
granularity_rationale.funding: Checklist on a 30-day recurring check-in. Null SLA by design: a matter waiting three months on a county clerk should not sit permanently red for a delay nobody at the firm can act on.

plan_types.note: Values are lib/designPlanType.ts DesignPlanType keys. Only pour_over carries a funded revocable trust, so the certificate of trust and the assignment of personal property gate on it alone.

task.title: Send proposal + engagement agreement — {client_name}
task.description: Auto-generate the proposal and EA from PMPS data and route to SignWell. Should go out before the next task begins.

checklist.text: Generate the proposal and EA from PMPS data

task.on_complete_hint: Completing this typically coincides with the matter advancing to EA Pending Signature.

task.title: Design the plan — {client_name}
task.description: Turn the intake into a design sheet the generator can run. The SLA starts at the design meeting, not at intake.

checklist.text: Review intake responses and flag gaps
Run the MA estate tax analysis
Seed the design sheet from intake
Collect the current deed and title

task.title: Draft documents — {client_name}
task.description: Generate, review, and send the draft package. Batch with other matters at this stage. Each document is one checklist item — ticking it is what says the document exists.

checklist.text: Run document generator from design payload
Draft the last will and testament
Draft the durable power of attorney
Draft the assignment of personal property
Review output against the design sheet
Cross-check named parties across all documents
Send drafts with review summary + revision form

task.title: Incorporate revisions — {client_name} (round {review_round})
task.description: Process the structured revision request. Handle in the Tue/Thu revision batch.

checklist.text: Make substantive edits and cross-check ripple
Resolve or reply to question items

round_cap_check.over_cap: Flag for fee conversation before processing.

task.title: Prepare the signing — {client_name}
task.description: The appointment is the client's to schedule; the preparation is not. Fires on entry so the package is ready before the date arrives.

checklist.text: Confirm the appointment with the client
Print and assemble the signing package

task.title: Closeout — {client_name}
task.description: Produce and deliver the post-signing package; close the matter.

checklist.text: Confirm executed documents stored to OneDrive
Generate and send the estate plan summary

task.title: Fund the trust — {client_name}
task.description: Retitling, beneficiary changes and waiting on the county run for as long as they run. A 30-day check-in, not a deadline.

checklist.text: Confirm funding complete with the client

on_stage_entry: When a matter enters an attorney-owned stage, look up the matching template by stage_key.
Skip the template entirely when its own `gate` does not pass for this matter.
Build the checklist from the items whose `gate` passes.
Compute soft_due_at = stage_entered_at + soft_lead_days (business days); hard_due_at = stage_entered_at + sla_days, or null when sla_days is null.
Create the task (or checklist with sub-items) in the app's task system, assigned to the attorney, with batch_tag for grouping.
Idempotency: one task per (matter_id, stage_key, stage_entered_at) — same pin as the nudge log, so a re-entry into the stage (e.g. revisions round 2) creates a fresh task.
on_plan_flag_change: Reconcile the open task for the current stage against the flags as they now stand.
A flag turned on appends its items, unchecked, at the end.
A flag turned off removes only items that are still incomplete. A completed item stays — it records work that actually happened, and deleting it would erase the record.
fire_logic.on_stage_exit: Optionally auto-complete or archive the open task for the stage being left, so stale tasks don't linger when the exit trigger fires.
fire_logic.matters_table_assumption: Reuses stage_entered_at, track, current_stage already required by the stage engine. No new matter fields.

task_table_suggestion.description: If tasks are persisted (vs. created directly in the app's native task store), this is the minimal shape.

stage_tasks.title: text
stage_tasks.checklist: jsonb (array of { text, done, produces_document?, gate? })

dashboard_integration.description: These tasks ARE the 'My Queue' from the aged dashboard, now actionable.
rules: My Queue task list = stage_tasks where status='open', ordered by hard_due_at, then soft_due_at.
Amber when now >= soft_due_at; red when now >= hard_due_at (mirrors v_matter_aging health).
A task with a null hard_due_at never goes red — it recurs on its soft date instead.
batch_tag lets the attorney filter to a work block: all 'drafting_qa' together, all 'revisions' on Tue/Thu.
